description: MainActivity.kt sets up the main activity with bottom navigation, a floating action button for checkout, and fragments for Home, Cart, Orders, and Profile screens. It manages fragment swapping and order placement logic.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity handling bottom navigation, fragment transactions, and checkout FAB.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes layout, view bindings, sets up bottom navigation listener, and defines checkout button behavior.

methods.name: onNavigationItemSelected
methods.description: Handles bottom navigation item selection, swaps fragments accordingly, and toggles checkout button visibility.
